name: Obeying
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of obedience to God as an expression of love and faithfulness, promising blessings and security to those who keep His commandments (Exodus 19:5; John 14:15; Luke 11:28). Obedience is not only directed toward God but also extends to human authorities and parents, with the understanding that God's authority supersedes all (Acts 5:29). Jesus teaches that hearing and doing His words is the foundation of wisdom and stability in life (Matthew 7:24), while the call to love God includes keeping His statutes and judgments consistently (Deuteronomy 11:1).
